reason: This package is a native provenance probe and release gate, not an implementation package.
enforcement: Any `cad-core/src`, `cad-core/include`, tests, fixtures expected, adapters or capability wording edits require a later S6-authorized package.

non_goal: Output order, bbox, EdgeN count, topology count, fixture name or current-ledger inference as provenance
reason: ProjectOnSurface mapper/history must be source-backed; geometric summaries and current cad-core fields cannot prove native ownership.
enforcement: S4 artifacts that lack source endpoint to target endpoint native history evidence remain native_hidden_retained or product_boundary_rejected.

non_goal: GUI session, Workbench command state, ViewProvider or TaskPanel lifecycle
reason: CAD Core is request-local and must not depend on GUI session, ViewProvider, workbench state or interactive command lifecycle.
enforcement: Rows requiring GUI or Workbench state are product_boundary_rejected.

non_goal: Cross-request native document, persistent TopoDS, NamedShape or ElementMap cache
reason: CAD Core receives full graph per request and does not keep native document or geometry state across requests.
enforcement: Rows requiring persistent native cache cannot become backend gap candidates.

non_goal: Full BREP transport as product API
reason: Repository boundary excludes full modeling BREP input/output except the existing ReferenceShadow.brep snapshot exception.
enforcement: Oracle artifacts may carry local evidence, but C12-M3 cannot expand product DTO to full BREP.

non_goal: Native-hidden, collector bug, crash or timeout as backend gap
reason: These outcomes prove missing oracle or probe instability, not cad-core mismatch.
enforcement: S5/S6 may record blockers but cannot authorize code from these classes alone.

non_goal: C5-M9 source-backed known-gap expected as native expected
reason: C5-M9 expected is current context and delete-condition evidence only; it is not a FreeCAD native MapperHistory or ElementMap artifact.
enforcement: S4 must produce native_provenance_expected_ready before S5 comparison; otherwise no expected/current mismatch can be claimed.
